a.text: This is Houei, a land where our ancestors have hunted for generations.
However, the peace we enjoy is disturbed every decade or so, when the Iju descends from the Gyorin, and brings its dread curse with it.
This is the trial of the Gyorin, one we must overcome.
Lords of Houei past—mine ancestors, that is—acted as the Gyorin's miko, bearing the burden of lifting the curse, and the duty of hunting the Iju.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So were those beasts with the black smoke this 'Iju'?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Nay, they are merely afflicted by the curse, becoming violent and rabid.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Iju is an exceptionally formidable beast, incomparable to the cursed beasts thou hast seen.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Were the curse left to fester within them, it may spread, and become an inexcisable thorn in our side.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: But you said we're the ones you were looking for. Where do we come in?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: It is not only the Iju and its curse that descend from the Gyorin once a decade. Two Iju Hunters always arrive as well.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Each generation of Hunters undertakes this trial alongside the Lord of Houei, hunting the Iju and dispelling its curse, thereby restoring a transient peace to the land.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: And you think we're those hunters?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: There must be some sort of mistake. We're not 'Iju Hunters' in the slightest...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Indeed.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The line of lords has been granted a wondrous connection to the Gyorin. I have felt its shift these past days, which bade me leave in search of ye.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And as I am unfamiliar with both your dress and your foreign tongue... ye must have been sent by the Gyorin.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Why insist on doing this 'trial' in the first place? It didn't sound like you were getting anything out of it.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: There is a benefit. The trial is both a challenge, and a gift.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: 'By Heaven's will shall we abide, o'er hunts of beasts shall we preside.' This is the rule Houei has abided by for centuries.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...What happened to the previous Iju Hunters?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: At the end of each hunt, the lord of the land absorbs the Iju's curse and restarts the Gyorin. Most choose to return to their homelands, but some few have decided to stay.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The annals of Houei have recorded the lives of every generation of Hunters.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: So, long story short, we just need to take care of this Iju thing, then we can go home.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Doesn't sound too bad, Orchid.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Nothing's ever that simple.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Fear not, for I shall not force ye to accept immediately.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The capital lies ahead. Whatever your questions, they may wait until we have arrived.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Travelers from afar, I bid ye welcome to our capital, Houei City.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Our nation is surrounded by groves of bamboo, and travelers oft become lost within them. But past the forest, ye shall see—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Is something the matter?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: What is that thing...?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: What thing?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Over there, in the distance.
Indeed. Houei City by itself would not have shocked Orchid.
However, what they are now seeing is beyond even Catapult's wildest dreams—
Far past the city, a metal archway quietly towers over the snowy mountains.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Are you guys seriously not surprised by that huge steel arch?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: 'Steel arch'? A strange way to put it.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: That is the Gyorin.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: The Gyorin...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Yes. It is the Gyorin that sends us the Iju, but it is also the Gyorin that sends us the Iju Hunters.
Orchid looks up, gazing at the 'Gyorin'.
Sunlight streams down, falling upon the fine engravings etched into the arch, engravings as delicate as spider's silk. For a moment, the light refracts into dazzling iridescence.
From a distance, it is like a steel rainbow—magnificent, divine. However, this beautiful 'rainbow' provokes a great unease in her, though she knows not why.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I blame thee not for thy surprise.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Gyorin is our national treasure, a relic passed down for millennia. Its like cannot be made today.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...I see.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: If it draws thy curiosity, we may speak more on it later.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Ahhhhh, too much stuff I don't get! My stomach's going crazy!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't make weird excuses for being hungry.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Let's go. Just another mystery for the pile.

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: Look, it's Her Majesty Hofukaru!

steps.name: Houei Commoner B
steps.text: And she has two people with her! Does that mean—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, check it out, all the townspeople are gathering up. Guess they don't get to see people like us very often.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Hey, how ya doing!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Don't—*sigh* Forget it.

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: Your Majesty, are these two the Iju Hunters?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Quietly) Hofukaru... I mean, Your Majesty, we've still got questions, so let's not give them false hope, shall we?

steps.name: Houei Commoner B
steps.text: If the Hunters are here, Your Majesty, this means that the decade's trial will be proceeding as normal, yes?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: (Quietly) Your Majesty?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...My good people, your eyes do not deceive you. These two are indeed the Iju Hunters of the trial!

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: Thank goodness...

steps.name: Houei Commoner B
steps.text: The gods have not abandoned us...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Ten years ago, the Lord of Thunder descended unto the realm of man.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: At the time, it was the Iju Hunters Sir Masamune and Sir Yoshitsune who accompanied the former lord, mine own mother, to face the Lord of Thunder, but—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Mother was unable to hunt the Lord, and vanished partway through. Sirs Masamune and Yoshitsune suffered grievous injuries.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This was unheard of in our history. Our chronicles had never recorded what would happen if we failed a trial.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And thus did our nation fall to chaos.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But rejoice, for today—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The Gyorin has not abandoned us! New Iju Hunters have arrived!

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: Are you two really Iju Hunters?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: We...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I suppose we are.

steps.name: Houei Commoner B
steps.text: Then you must be mighty warriors, yes?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Heh, naturally!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I pledge to you that I shall carry on my mother's mission. I shall accompany these Hunters in their hunt for the Iju, and complete this trial.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But there is more—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: To this very day, the Lord of Thunder and its curse wreak havoc at the borders of Houei.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I was still young at the time, unable to make such promises, and unable to avenge my mother. The Lord of Thunder was akin to a thorn in my heart, one I could not pluck out.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I had but one wish, and now, I can say—

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Once this hunt is complete, I shall hunt the Lord of Thunder as well, thereby completing my mother's unfinished duty and restoring peace to Houei!

steps.name: Houei Commoner A
steps.text: Amazing! I knew you would think of a way, Your Majesty! Long live Lady Hofukaru!

steps.name: Houei Commoner B
steps.text: Don't get ahead of yourself. Remember what happened last time.

steps.name: Houei Commoner C
steps.text: Even so, Her Majesty is wise beyond her years. That's something worth celebrating, right? Long live Lady Hofukaru!

steps.name: Houei Commoner B
steps.text: Hey, look, I'm not doubting Her Majesty!

steps.name: Houei Commoner B
steps.text: ...Long live Lady Hofukaru!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Wait, d-don't push me! You're wrinkling my clothes! And don't you dare try and toss me!

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: It's like we're heroes, Orchid!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: But this isn't what she told us—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I mean, you're not wrong. But I never thought I'd see Popukar of all people pulling one over on us. Haha.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Remember a certain someone who always wanted her to think for herself a little more?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Shut it!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Pray forgive me for drawing you into my plans.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Eh, no biggie.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: I, for one, enjoyed the hero's welcome.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Can't say the same for Orchid, though. She can't stand this sort of thing, so you'd better give her a proper apology.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Madam Orchid—

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Oh, those teary eyes. Now that's the girl I know.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Guess you didn't need to apologize after all.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Eh?

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: You were definitely thinking something like 'my little Popukar's all grown up', weren't you, Orchid?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Shut it.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: *sigh*...

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You had your reasons, yes?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...I did.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: You are certainly the Hunters, and upon defeating the Iju, you shall be able to pass through the Gyorin and return home. That much is no lie.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Ordinarily, the lords of Houei would not have had to use such underhanded tricks to compel you into accepting this duty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: So allow me to explain, with a story from the past.
The Iju of ten years ago... is a nightmare plaguing all of Houei.
Now known as the Lord of Thunder, its strength and agility far exceed any previous Iju. Not only that, it has the power to command both thunder and levin as it pleases.
And as I said in the square earlier...
My mother, the former lord, was unable to complete the hunt, even disappearing in the middle of it.
Something unprecedented in the history of our nation.
The Iju undefeated, the curse undissipated.
The past ten years have had us suffer attacks from both the Lord of Thunder and increasingly frequent raids from the cursed beasts.
But what is most frightening is that—
All are at a loss. None can say if this is a punishment from the Gyorin, or perhaps some other mishap.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: As for me...

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I have but one wish: to hunt the Lord of Thunder. In so doing, we will avenge my mother and bring peace to my nation.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Then why haven't you done it already? You're the local lord, right? Is someone stopping you?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Midnight, I presume?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...It is.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I was still young when Mother passed, so he served as my regent. But much has changed over this past decade.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: He summoned all hunters of the realm to the palace, declaring that they were no longer hunters, but samurai. He had them registered, and established the Hunter's Association, which he personally oversees.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And from that moment on, he took the title of shogun.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: The people have grown accustomed to a life of being unable to hunt freely. Still, we yet live, albeit under the shadow of the Lord of Thunder.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I shall admit that without him, we would not be enjoying the support of the people. The nation of Houei may not have even survived.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: However, when it comes to the very source of our nation's ills, he refuses to entertain the notion of hunting it, even forbidding me from challenging it.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Why?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: He merely says the time is not yet right.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Then how will you know when it is?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...He has insisted that I complete at least three trials first.

steps.name: Catapult
steps.text: Three trials... That's thirty years, isn't it?!

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: When Mother challenged the Lord of Thunder, she had already passed three trials. And so he demands the same of me.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But I cannot wait that long.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This shall be my first trial, and I shall use it to prove myself capable!

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: ...So that's why you were so eager for us to take the job.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Correct.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Over the past ten years, every time I have wanted to challenge the Lord of Thunder, he would appear behind my shoulder like some sort of demon, urging me to reconsider.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: I have no intention of being belittled, nor do I intend to keep putting off unfinished business.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Your Majesty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: An attendant? Tell the shogun that I have located the Iju Hunters.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: He is already aware.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Hmph.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: According to our scouts, an unusually vicious group of Escorchgot have appeared in the bamboo forest east of the capital. They are most likely under the influence of the Iju.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And what does the shogun intend?

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: As a new trial has begun, he will not interfere.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Going forward, I will relay all relevant information to Your Majesty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Understood. Inform the shogun that I will be setting off at once.

steps.name: Samurai
steps.text: Understood.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: Sounds like he figured you out.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: A most vexing man.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: At least he won't stop you this time.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: This is how he hath always done things. He will watch from afar, patiently waiting for me to admit that I am incapable.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: But I never will.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: And thus must I ask thee to aid me. Thou needest not even participate in the hunt, if thou art unwilling. I shall defeat the Iju, and send thee home.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: I've still got a lot of questions, but I'll stick to one for now.

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: You said every past Iju hunt was a success... Has every Iju Hunter before us accepted the mission?

steps.name: Orchid
steps.text: None of them thought of running away, or refusing?

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: ...Some did.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: In truth, the records do speak of many other Iju Hunters who held doubts and refused the mantle.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: However, for various reasons, they all ultimately agreed to take on their duty.

steps.name: Hofukaru
steps.text: Our chronicles state that—

a.text: Those who hunt Iju are not chosen by the Gyorin.
Their own selves they shall know, their own greed they shall taste, their own bravery they shall measure, their own tools they shall obtain, their own fates they shall fulfill.
